long_biography.plain_text:
Chirulli began working for himself as a teenager, using a mechanical shovel financed with help from his father. Early agricultural land-clearing and excavation work led to quarry operations, then to road contracts. A major highway-modernisation project allowed the business to add concrete and asphalt plants, creating an integrated supply chain around materials and infrastructure work.

When Italy's construction market weakened, Chirulli established operations in Romania and used that expansion to sustain the group until domestic activity recovered. The resulting platform now combines quarrying, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, logistics and road construction, with a smaller hospitality division. His career is defined by direct operating involvement, repeated reinvestment in machinery and the ability to expand from subcontracting into larger public-infrastructure projects.
